The '''full-spectrum optical enhancer''' was a model of [[Enhanced optics suite/Legends|enhanced optics suite]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] enhancement produced by [[Atlas Corp]] and sold for 1750 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The suite was available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The system included a number of [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] installed into a user's helmet which increased awareness of their surrounding space.<ref name="EOTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The full spectrum optical enhancer was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2013]]. The same information was also included in the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]] released the [[2014|following year]] by Fantasy Flight Games.
